summary: Scrape a web page, list a site's pages and crawl a site through Firecrawl. Needs FIRECRAWL_API_KEY in .env (or FIRECRAWL_API_URL for a self-hosted instance).

tools.name: tool_scrape_page
tools.purpose: Scrape one web page as markdown.

tools.name: tool_scrape_map
tools.purpose: List the pages found on a site.

tools.name: tool_scrape_crawl
tools.purpose: Crawl a site and return the text of its pages.

params.name: url
params.description: The full http:// or https:// address of the page.

params.name: url
params.description: The full http:// or https:// address of the site or section.

params.name: limit
params.description: How many pages to list at most (1 to 500).

params.name: url
params.description: The full http:// or https:// address where the crawl starts.

params.name: limit
params.description: How many pages to read at most (1 to 25).

workflow.explanation: List a site's pages and pick the ones to read.
Or crawl from a starting address when you need many pages.
